title: RNA sequencing of GPRC5C-Knockdown (GPRC5C-KD) and control CD34+ human bone marrow
description: The transcriptome of shGPR and shRenilla in human CD34+ bone marrow was assessed by RNAseq.

samples.title: Ren_Ctlr_1
samples.description: Protocols: CD34+ bone marrow cells (StemCell Technology) were thawed and prestimulated in culture for 24h. Cells were transduced with lentivirus of shGPR and shRenilla. Positively transduced cells were marked by GFP and sorted using the FACS Aria III (Becton Dickinson) at the MPI FACS facility, Freiburg, Germany. The following sort parameters were used: 100 um nozzle with approximately10,000 evt/s. 1000 GFP+ cells were collected into ice-cold RNA lysis buffer (ARCTURUS PicoPure RNA Isolation Kit (Life Technologies, Invitrogen)) and stored at -80C until further usage. Total RNA isolation was performed from the indicated populations using ARCTURUS PicoPure RNA Isolation Kit (Life Technologies, Invitrogen) according to the manufacturers instructions. DNAse treatment was performed using RNAse-free DNAse Set (Qiagen). Total RNA was used as starting material for cDNA-libraries preparation using the Low Input RNA: cDNA Synthesis, Amplification and Library Generation (NEB #E6420). 14 PCR cycles were used for cDNA amplification and 10 cycles for PCR enrichment.
